name: Suiren
source:
Rikka's brother. Originally the eldest son of the Beyondaris family, but since he is the son of a concubine, he is not counted. He is cold-hearted, strict with both himself and others, and has an arrogant attitude. He hates Rikka and Sekka. Temari is the most important person to him.

[Translated from [url=http://magichouse.uh-oh.jp/05blind_3.html]official website[/url]]
